ideas.pitch: Real-time cold chain monitoring and predictive spoilage detection for agricultural supply chains using low-cost edge sensors and machine learning.
ideas.title: AgriChain IoT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a high-impact local socioeconomic problem with a complete end-to-end hardware-to-cloud demo, mirroring the clear measurable impact pattern seen in winning projects.

ideas.pitch: Dynamic, real-time emergency ambulance routing system that coordinates with smart traffic infrastructure to optimize transit times in congested urban areas.
ideas.title: MedRoute AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent, highly visible daily urban challenge in India, providing judges with an immediately recognizable and quantifiable value proposition.

ideas.pitch: Personalized technical upskilling platform that analyzes regional engineering student resumes against local industry job market gaps to generate custom micro-learning modules.
ideas.title: SkillBridge AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to an engineering college audience and evaluation panel by addressing local graduate employability with tangible data metrics.

ideas.pitch: Microgrid load balancing and anomaly detection dashboard that predicts local transformer failures before they happen using time-series forecasting models.
ideas.title: GridGuardian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering through advanced time-series modeling and anomaly detection, matching technical execution seen in top-tier hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: Crowdsourced urban infrastructure degradation analyzer that uses computer vision to automatically categorize and severity-score potholes and waterlogging from smartphone dashcam video.
ideas.title: CivicEye
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical computer vision with municipal utility, satisfying judges looking for scalable software solutions to civic problems.
